mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correctCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wrongCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ungradedCount FROM answer_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT CASE q.type WHEN 1 THEN '单选题' WHEN 2 THEN '多选题' WHEN 3 THEN '填空题' WHEN 4 THEN '简答题' ELSE '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct FROM answer_record a JOIN question q ON a.question_id = q.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY q.type ORDER BY q.type

SELECT CASE q.difficulty WHEN 1 THEN '简单' WHEN 2 THEN '中等' WHEN 3 THEN '困难' ELSE '未设' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct FROM answer_record a JOIN question q ON a.question_id = q.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY q.difficulty ORDER BY q.difficulty

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(q.subject, ''), '未知') AS name, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct FROM answer_record a JOIN question q ON a.question_id = q.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(q.subject, ''), '未知') ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct FROM answer_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date`

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(q.knowledge_point, ''), '未分类') AS knowledgePoint, COUNT(*) AS wrongCount FROM answer_record a JOIN question q ON a.question_id = q.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_correct = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(q.knowledge_point, ''), '未分类') ORDER BY wrongCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
